For building service contractors

The alternative to hiring another cleaning crew.

You already have a labor line on every contract. Put a robot on it instead of your next hire — one machine covers the overnight floors, and it never quits, no-shows, or asks for a raise.

Service Robot Co. deploys and services autonomous cleaning robots — Pudu CC1 and Gausium Scrubber units — for building service contractors who clean multiple sites under contract. Instead of hiring your next cleaning crew, you run a robot on the labor line. We select the machine, deploy it, service it nationwide, and help you add units as you win more contracts.

Get a quoteTalk to us about a fleet

/ the wedge

You're not buying a robot. You're skipping a hire.

Every contract you run has a labor line on it: the overnight crew that scrubs, sweeps, and vacuums the floors. Cleaning-labor turnover runs 75%–375% a year, so that line never stops needing backfill — a robot fills the seat you're always trying to fill.

We don't sell against other robots. We sell against your next job posting. Put the robot where you'd put the next hire, on the floors that eat the most labor hours every night.

If you're actively hiring for outside cleaning right now, a robot belongs in that conversation before the req does.

/ what it replaces

One machine, the overnight floors.

Mixed floors, tight spaces — malls, offices, retail

Pudu CC1 (4-in-1)

The generalist unit for a contract with several floor types on one site.

Mid-size hard floors — hospitals, hotels, offices

Gausium Scrubber 50 / 50 Pro

Daily scrub runs on mid-size open floor plates.

Large hard floors — warehouses, big-box, malls

Gausium Scrubber 75 / 75 Pro

The largest open floor plates in your book of business.

We match the unit to the site, not the other way around — a contract with three different building types can run three different robots under one relationship with us.

Does it cost less than the crew it replaces?

That's the only question that matters, and it's a real comparison, not a brochure range: your monthly labor cost for that shift versus the monthly cost of running the robot. We quote every job against your actual hours and floors — see how ROI math works on a commercial robot for the mechanism, and what a cleaning robot actually costsfor what's inside the number.

We don't publish a payback chart because your labor rate, your square footage, and your shift length aren't ours to guess. Get a free site assessmentand we'll run the real number for your contract.

/ fleet across contracts

Add a robot every time you add a contract.

A BSC doesn't run one site — you run a book of them. So this isn't a one-robot decision. As you win new contracts, you add units the same way you'd add a crew: one relationship, one number to call, robots matched per site across your whole book. 38% of BSCs now see clients asking for automation directly in their RFPs — a fleet already in place answers that before it's asked.

One partner, every site.

We deploy and service every unit across every building you run, not just the first one.

Nationwide.

Coverage across all 50 US states, backed by regional service engineers and depots nationwide — a broken robot on any contract is our problem, not yours.

Backup on hand.

If a unit goes down mid-contract, we swap it. You keep your SLA with your client intact.

Common questions

Is this only for one building, or my whole book of contracts?
Your whole book. We deploy and service a robot on any contract you run, and add units as you add contracts.
What if my contract ends and the robot needs to move?
The robot moves with the contract you assign it to — talk to us about relocating a unit between sites.
Do I still need a night crew?
Usually a smaller one. The robot covers the repetitive floor work; people still handle detail cleaning, restrooms, and anything off the robot's route.
What proof of service do I show my client?
Every run is logged — floor, time, and how it cleaned — through the robot's dashboard, so you can show your client the work happened.
Can I add a robot to a new contract fast?
Tell us the site and the floors; we quote and can typically deploy within days, not months.
